row.body: B5's pick re-points the fills only. Measured: after re-pointing, the info tint-note mark (the tint #DFEAF9) on the #78A7E8 roundel is 2.03:1 and the inline info mark (the page #FFFFFF) is 2.47:1, against 6.21 and 7.17 today; the mono map's mark #1A1A1A gives 7.04. The mono success roundel already fails today: white mark on #66CC8D 1.98:1 (mark-success #1A1A1A gives 8.77). Taking the global bar's text from the --mark-* carriers changes Legacy, Console and Supercharge too (their warning mark is #000000, so the warn bar text there goes #333333 -> #000000); the s158-D1 guard mechanism is how a theme keeps its paint if Dave wants that. The driftAllow $reason quotes R-D19 'do not convert - retag to the Legacy theme': this build is that conversion for mono, and the themes already project their own fills.
